parsed.note_claim: He was shot and killed by Lee Harvey Oswald on November 22, 1963.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: On Friday, November 22, 1963, John F. Kennedy , the 35th president of the United States , was assassinated while riding in a presidential motorcade through Dallas , Texas.
parsed.reason: The page explicitly confirms the date of the assassination and that Kennedy was fatally shot by Lee Harvey Oswald in the subsequent sentence.
